Convert odds between any formats

Source: R/models_eval.R
convert_odds.Rd

Convenience function to convert odds between decimal, fractional, and American formats.

Usage

convert_odds(odds, from, to)

Arguments

odds

Numeric or character. Input odds.

from

Character. Input format: "decimal", "fractional", or "american".

to

Character. Output format: "decimal", "fractional", or "american".

Value

Odds in the target format.

See also

Other odds: american_to_decimal(), decimal_to_american(), decimal_to_fractional(), fractional_to_decimal()
